EVENT-LEDGER LAW: a drift row books ONLY on a real transition — FIRST-DELTA (baseline) or DRIFT; NO-DRIFT days book nothing and commit nothing (composes with the no-noise publish law: on a byte-frozen estate neither the map nor the delta books anything); SKIP-INVALID-TO books nothing (a broken/STASIS-HALT map is the census desk's signal, delta never invents transitions from it). Byte-deterministic for the same input pair; fail-soft exit 0; STASIS halt BEFORE any read with ZERO writes (unlike the map desk, the event ledger gets no halt rows). The workflow delta step now diffs artifact-vs-artifact (git HEAD) for the CI-perspective drift series while the canonical map stays full-estate — E35 in run-evals v1.21.0 -> v1.22.0: NINE expectations (white-box exact DRIFT transitions + estate stamp, PERSPECTIVE law, at/ok-only NO-DRIFT, invalid-map null-safety incl. error/STASIS-HALT books, byte-determinism, real-estate fresh-process, STASIS halt-before-read zero-writes, SINGLE-LANE-WORKSPACE artifact mode fresh-process with canonical-untouched + FIRST-DELTA series start) — two in-session defects caught by the eval discipline (mkB undefined; a sha guard written tautologically) and one semantic fix (lane MISSING is a statusChange, not a registry miss) — evals 33/33, parse-gate GREEN, full chain.
